About Uncle Lee's Cafe

Nestled in the heart of Houston, Texas, Uncle Lee's Cafe is a hidden gem offering a unique and flavorful dining experience. Located at 9203 S Texas 6, this cozy spot is known for its inviting atmosphere and exceptional dishes that keep guests coming back for more. Whether you're a fan of savory comfort food or adventurous eats, Uncle Lee's has something to satisfy every craving.

One of the standout dishes is the sautéed mixed vegetables, which has become a favorite for many due to its perfectly cooked assortment of fresh veggies bathed in a rich, savory sauce. For those who love a flavorful protein, the pepper beef is a must-try, featuring tender beef cooked to perfection and packed with the bold flavors of bell peppers. The chili oil noodles, a popular dish at the cafe, strike a balance that is often hard to achieve. With the perfect texture and just the right amount of heat, these noodles stand out as a favorite among customers, offering a delightful slurp-worthy experience.

For those seeking more variety, Uncle Lee's Cafe also offers sour soup dumplings, which are known for their vibrant flavors and generous portions. The Chinese burger, featuring pulled pork belly, is another highlight, offering a unique twist that caters to both adventurous eaters and those looking for something familiar yet exciting. Adding chicken to the oil splashed noodles creates an even more intense flavor profile, perfect for anyone craving a spicy kick that’s sure to clear your sinuses.

The friendly service adds to the overall experience, with staff being attentive and mindful of portions, ensuring that diners don’t end up overwhelmed by the generous servings. With dishes that highlight the rich flavors of Chinese cuisine, Uncle Lee's Cafe continues to earn a loyal following, making it a must-visit spot for anyone in the area.

Reviews

“ Absolutely incredible hole in the wall spot. The sautéed mixed vegetables was actually my favorite dish here. There was a good assortment of all my favorite veggies, and the sauce that it was cooked with was so savory and delicious. The pepper beef was cooked well and packed with incredible flavors from the bell peppers. As for the chili oil noodles, I’m very picky about them because some places can easily make them too greasy, sweet, sour, or salty… but the sauce was perfectly balanced in all aspects. The noodles had a wonderful bite to them, but I think it was more like one long noodle so be prepared to slurp and bite… I will definitely be coming back to try more dishes as I think I’ve found a new favorite! ”

Bryan Vi

“ The lamb soup is quite good. The broth is mellow, and the lamb is very tender. However, the Chinese burger didn’t appeal to me. It was too dry and salty. The restaurant could also benefit from a bit more cleanliness. ”

Brian Chiu

“ First time coming and I'm very pleased. I heard about this mom and pops place from TikTok and had to try it. We got the oil splashed noodles, Cumin lamb, lamb dumpling soup and salted pepper chicken. It was all delicious and had a kick to it...must like spicy. Staff was very welcoming and the environment very clean. They did recommend a lot of different items which was very nice. Poor waitress was so busy and there was one cook. They both did an amazing job and we will definitely be coming back. ”

Raquel

“ We went to this place twice in a week. We were served with authentic northern chinese dishes. Most famous dishes are Xian Cold Noodles, Chinese Burger, Lamb with Bread Soup and Oil Splashed Noodles! Their price can be found in the Xian Famous sections of the menu. The staffs are very nice, told us lots of details about their dishes and what’s the best way to eat them. We were eating there during weekday. Hopefully you will get good recommendations during weekend or busy dinner hours. ”

John Fwu

“ The food came out amazing! The beef was perfectly seasoned, tender and juicy. The noodles were soft and delicious. My respects the to chef. I’ll definitely be coming back. ”

Jailene Ochoa

“ This place slaps! Delicious Northwest Chinese cuisine. Truly don’t understand why it isn’t a 5 stars. You cannot find Xian-style hand pulled noodles in Houston. I usually get the oil splashed noodles and add beef. It’s delicious. Make sure to mix it before you start eating. I’ve also had the roujiamao burger here as well as it is another well-known dish from this part of China. People that work here are super nice. I always strike up a convo here and there trying to convince them to franchise. Wish it was closer to downtown, but it’s kinda one of those iykyk places. Sometimes it’s better like that. ”

P Charles

“ Saw the oil splashed noodles on social media and had to check it out! Unless Lee's brought it! Ready with photos, recommendations, and 5-star service. They even cut us off when ordering because they know their portions and warned us, "You have a lot of food coming." We'll be back to try more! Sour soup dumplings: absolute must Extremely flavorful and plenty of them. Chinese burger: pulled pork belly - Can go either way on this. Thought it was unique and great for the less adventurous among you. I put the dumpling sauce on mine and Oil splashed noodles: you gotta. We added chicken and pretty sure they tried to clear my sinuses but worth it. There's also a party trick to cutting the noodles, but you'll have to visit Lee's to find out. ⭐⭐⭐⭐ ”

Kirsten Cornell

“ Good flavors and big selection. Our waiter recommended the big chicken and noodle dish but I think you can skip that. It was a huge bowl with noodles and chicken with bones. Sauce was similar to curry. The standard noodle dishes we had were better. The spice level was pretty good. I did notice the noodles felt inconsistent. Some were a tad undercooked and others would have tasted better warm and not cold. The best dish which was surprising was the orange chicken. This is not your typical fast food orange chicken you have had. The orange peel really adds to the flavor and you can smell the orange citrus. Seemed like a nice family run Chinese restaurant. ”

Lawrence Tam
